name: io.github.jeffforderer/barbaro
title: Barbaro
description: Explore pizzas and ingredients and calculate custom dough recipes with your assistant.

tools.name: search_pizzas
tools.description: Search published house pizzas. Returns public catalog data with source links and credits.

q.description: Literal, case-insensitive substring of published names, descriptions or resolved ingredient names. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

limit.description: Decimal integer page size. Leading zeros, signs and fractions are rejected.

offset.description: Decimal integer result offset. Leading zeros, signs and fractions are rejected.

tools.name: get_pizza
tools.description: Read a published house pizza by UUID or slug. Returns public catalog data with source links and credits.

id.description: Canonical UUID or lowercase slug. UUIDs are case-insensitive; UUID-shaped identifiers resolve only as canonical IDs and cannot be slugs.

tools.name: read_menu
tools.description: Read published menu sections and their pizza IDs. Returns public catalog data with source links and credits.

tools.name: search_ingredients
tools.description: Search published ingredient facts. Returns public catalog data with source links and credits.

q.description: Literal, case-insensitive name substring. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

course.description: One exact normalized course. No legacy-station fallback.

limit.description: Decimal integer page size. Leading zeros, signs and fractions are rejected.

offset.description: Decimal integer ingredient result offset. Leading zeros, signs and fractions are rejected.

tools.name: get_ingredient
tools.description: Read a published ingredient by UUID. Returns public catalog data with source links and credits.

id.description: Canonical ingredient UUID only, case-insensitive. Ingredient slugs are not globally unique.

tools.name: search_flours
tools.description: Search published flour facts. Returns public catalog data with source links and credits.

q.description: Literal, case-insensitive name or brand substring. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

limit.description: Decimal integer page size. Leading zeros, signs and fractions are rejected.

offset.description: Decimal integer result offset. Leading zeros, signs and fractions are rejected.

tools.name: get_flour
tools.description: Read a published flour by UUID or slug. Returns public catalog data with source links and credits.

id.description: Canonical UUID or lowercase slug. UUIDs are case-insensitive; UUID-shaped identifiers resolve only as canonical IDs and cannot be slugs.

tools.name: calculate_dough
tools.description: Calculate a dough formula from explicit gram sizing, percentages and published or custom flours. Returns quantities, warnings, source information and a Dough continuation link. No persistence.

prefIsd.description: Instant sourdough mass as a percentage of total flour, not preferment flour. Convert a Dough preferment-page percentage with pagePercent * effectiveBigaFlour / totalFlour, using actual allocated preferment flour from results. Only without an allocation shortfall is pagePercent * pff / 100 equivalent. A zero actual preferment-flour weight makes its stage percentage unavailable. Example with full allocation: 1.60 * 15 / 100 = 0.24, giving 4.8 g at 2000 g total flour.

prefIdy.description: Instant dry yeast mass as a percentage of total flour, not preferment flour. Convert a Dough preferment-page percentage with pagePercent * effectiveBigaFlour / totalFlour, using actual allocated preferment flour from results. Only without an allocation shortfall is pagePercent * pff / 100 equivalent. A zero actual preferment-flour weight makes its stage percentage unavailable. Example with full allocation: 1.60 * 15 / 100 = 0.24, giving 4.8 g at 2000 g total flour.

finalIsd.description: Final-mix instant sourdough mass as a percentage of total flour. No stage-basis conversion is required.

finalIdy.description: Final-mix instant dry yeast mass as a percentage of total flour. No stage-basis conversion is required.

starterPrefPct.description: Preferment sourdough starter mass (including its flour and water) as a percentage of total flour, not preferment flour. Convert a Dough preferment-page percentage with pagePercent * effectiveBigaFlour / totalFlour, using actual allocated preferment flour from results. Only without an allocation shortfall is pagePercent * pff / 100 equivalent. A zero actual preferment-flour weight makes its stage percentage unavailable. Example with full allocation: 1.60 * 15 / 100 = 0.24, giving 4.8 g at 2000 g total flour.

starterFinalPct.description: Final-mix sourdough starter mass (including its flour and water) as a percentage of total flour. No stage-basis conversion is required.

bigaHydration.description: Preferment water as a percentage of preferment flour.

starterHydrationPct.description: Starter water as a percentage of starter flour, not total flour or starter mass.

starterFlourSource.description: blend or a supplied flour row ID. Inactive starter normalizes to blend and 100% hydration.

customAdjustments.description: Optional baker-named final-mix ingredients, up to 8, each a percentage of total flour. They count by weight only: they add to batch weight and ball sizing, never to hydration or flour absorption. Row IDs are c followed by five lowercase letters or digits, unique within the formula. Names are sent trimmed, 1 to 40 characters, unique ignoring case, and may not repeat one of Dough's own ingredient names such as Water, Salt, Oil or Sugar, or contain control, hidden or bidirectional characters or a web address. Any refused row fails the whole request.

inputSchema.description: Percentages refer to total flour, except bigaHydration and starterHydrationPct. Flour rows are ratios, including empty/zero blends. Unique row IDs required. Named starter source must be a supplied row. Preferment leavening requires positive pff. No temperature inputs; preparation fixes DDT at 72 F and friction at 15 F. Buffer defaults off and non-off buffer requires balls sizing. Flour mode has no ball target: prepared ballCount/ballWeight are zero, ballsTotal is zero, bufferG is the whole batch and pizzaSize is unavailable. The 100000 g flour bound applies to direct flour inputs, not the balls solver result. Custom ingredients count by weight only and never in hydration.

tools.name: calculate_balance
tools.description: Calculate six balance contribution totals and meters for unique published ingredient IDs. Not nutrition or ingredient weights. No persistence.

tools.name: plan_bake
tools.description: Caller-provided sequential, contiguous stages ending when the first pizza enters the oven. Offset-bearing whole-minute instants must match the IANA zone. No fermentation prediction. Unique stage IDs, positive total duration, minimum <= maximum, available horizon and summed maxima <= 30 days. Windows are marginal, not independently selectable. No persistence.

inputSchema.description: Caller-provided sequential, contiguous stages ending when the first pizza enters the oven. Offset-bearing whole-minute instants must match the IANA zone. No fermentation prediction. Unique stage IDs, positive total duration, minimum <= maximum, available horizon and summed maxima <= 30 days. Windows are marginal, not independently selectable.

tools.name: shopping_list
tools.description: One to eight uniquely identified, already-sized Dough requests. Optional unique published house pizza references and counts annotate topping needs only; they do not multiply dough. Custom flours and custom ingredients retain batch/row identity and are never merged across batches; a custom ingredient item's id is custom:<batchId>:<rowId>. Ready starter is separate from fresh ingredients. Topping quantities are unknown. No persistence.
